purpose: Test whether preserving the ordered eight-minute trajectory solves the weak cross-device precursor ranking seen in V38 while retaining the V37 device-invariant channel policy.

representation.base_channels: the 12 V35 fraction/concentration network channels only
representation.within_history_normalization: per-channel median / max(IQR, 0.10), computed from the eight-minute history only
representation.temporal_input: first differences of the normalized sequence

pre_forecast_invariance_gate.population: clean benign histories from the eight development devices only
pre_forecast_invariance_gate.folds: same four fixed two-device heldout folds as V37
pre_forecast_invariance_gate.domain_classifier: fixed logistic classifier on flattened 7x12 sequence
pre_forecast_invariance_gate.rule: abort attack forecasting if the exact temporal representation fails this benign-only invariance gate

temporal_protocol.target: annotated attack onset strictly after cutoff and within the next four minutes
temporal_protocol.event_denominator: test-device onsets with at least one eligible clean-history precursor window

primary.training_sampler: class-balanced weighted sampler; 30000 draws per epoch or full training size if smaller
primary.checkpoint_selection: lowest calibration log loss across epochs; test is never consulted

models.baseline: HistGradientBoostingClassifier on the same flattened 7x12 temporal input with fixed hyperparameters
models.calibration: Platt logistic on calibration device only
models.threshold_rule: for each budget use max(calibration-benign quantile, policy-benign quantile); among candidates with <=5.05% policy FPR choose highest policy positive-sequence recall, tie break lower policy FPR then lower budget

claim_boundary: V39 is development cross-device evidence only. Even a pass requires a newly reserved external corpus/campaign before any final pre-compromise or zero-day claim.
